name: The Gordok Ogre Suit

guaranteedRewards.name: Gordok Ogre Suit
tooltip: Use: Disguise yourself as one of the Gordok ogres, and maybe even fool a particular captain in the process! The suit will only hold together for 10 min.

statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.offerRewardText:
Here ya go adventurer - put this thing on, and you'll have ten minutes to do whatever.  Good luck!

Oh, and if you happen to find a key to get me out of here, BY ALL MEANS LET ME KNOW!!!
narrative.requestItemsText: Need another suit, do ya? Well, I'm not going anywhere soon it seems - bring me the same things I asked for from before, and I'll make you another ogre suit.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 6,600 XP in all.

quests.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
quests.objectiveText: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack.

objectiveItems.name: Rune Thread
sources: sold by Alexandra Bolero and 4 more
